sys_update_xml.name: sys_transform_entry_c40c535f2bb50710eb1cfbfdf291bffe
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_entry"><sys_transform_entry action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><choice_action>create</choice_action><coalesce>false</coalesce><coalesce_case_sensitive>false</coalesce_case_sensitive><coalesce_empty_fields>false</coalesce_empty_fields><date_format>yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss</date_format><map display_value="HP WXP Alert to Incident">ccf5939f2b750710eb1cfbfdf291bf79</map><reference_value_field/><source_field>[Script]</source_field><source_script><![CDATA[answer = (function transformEntry(source) {

    // Set when the incident is created: the alert's description, then the same alert details the
    // work note carries. A re-post keeps what the incident has - Copy empty fields is on, so
    // returning nothing here would blank it.
    if (action == 'update')
        return target.getValue('description');

    var text = source.getValue('u_description') || '';
    var details = new AlertIngest().alertDetails(source);
    if (!details)
        return text;
    return text ? text + '\n\n' + details : details;

})(source);]]></source_script><source_table>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_hp_alert_inc_import_set</source_table><sys_class_name>sys_transform_entry</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-06 07:23:37</sys_created_on><sys_id>c40c535f2bb50710eb1cfbfdf291bffe</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>[Script]</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_entry_c40c535f2bb50710eb1cfbfdf291bffe</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 18:29:29</sys_updated_on><target_field>description</target_field><target_table>incident</target_table><use_source_script>true</use_source_script></sys_transform_entry></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_script"><sys_transform_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><map display_value="HP WXP Alert to Incident">ccf5939f2b750710eb1cfbfdf291bf79</map><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[(function runTransformScript(source, map, log, target) {

    // Every column the field maps parse must be valid JSON. If one is not, fail the row
    // here rather than let a field map throw halfway through the transform.
    try {
        JSON.parse(source.u_companydetails || '{}');
        JSON.parse(source.u_devicedetails || '{}');
        JSON.parse(source.u_userdetails || '{}');
    } catch (e) {
        source.sys_import_state = 'error';
        source.sys_import_state_comment = e.message;
        log.error('Alert Transform Failed: ' + e.message);
        ignore = true;
        return;
    }

})(source, map, log, target);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_transform_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-08 12:06:54</sys_created_on><sys_id>cfef6a4ceb064b1030f9f95ccad0cdd1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>onBefore</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_script_cfef6a4ceb064b1030f9f95ccad0cdd1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 12:25:26</sys_updated_on><when>onBefore</when></sys_transform_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_fix_c77797822b44d754eb1cfbfdf291bf81
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix"><sys_script_fix action="DELETE"><before>false</before><description>Temporary test for certification point 4 (non-admin): evaluated as incidentConnect by a global impersonation script. Inserts test alerts. Runs only on ven07367. Delete before the next publish.</description><name>ZZ TEST - AM platform-default import che</name><record_for_rollback>true</record_for_rollback><script><![CDATA[// TEMPORARY TEST - delete before the next publish. HP WXP Alert Management, 22 Oct 2026.
// Tests the DEPLOYED AlertIngest.importBatch, unmodified, for certification point 4.
// Evaluated in the app scope as incidentConnect by a global script that impersonates it.
// B3: a batch of 3 new alerts. B10: one malformed alert and one good one.
// All alerts are NEW with fresh u_ids, so they only insert incidents and nothing goes to Fastn.
// Runs only on hp-dev (ven07367).
(function() {
    var TAG = '[AM-DEPLOYED-TEST]';
    var label = (typeof runLabel !== 'undefined') ? runLabel : 'manual';
    if (gs.getProperty('instance_name') != 'ven07367') {
        gs.info(TAG + ' skipped - not ven07367');
        return;
    }

    gs.info(TAG + ' ' + label + ' identity ' + JSON.stringify({
        user: gs.getUserName(),
        scope: gs.getCurrentScopeName(),
        admin: gs.hasRole('admin'),
        appUser: gs.hasRole('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.user')
    }));

    var runId = 'zz-deptest-' + label + '-' + new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue();

    report('B3-bulk', new AlertIngest().importBatch([buildAlert('b3-1'), buildAlert('b3-2'), buildAlert('b3-3')]));

    var bad = buildAlert('b10-bad');
    bad.u_devicedetails = '{not valid json';
    report('B10-bad-row', new AlertIngest().importBatch([bad, buildAlert('b10-good')]));

    gs.info(TAG + ' ' + label + ' done run=' + runId);

    function report(step, outcome) {
        var incidents = outcome.incidents || [];
        var summary = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < incidents.length; i++)
            summary.push({
                u_id: incidents[i].u_id,
                incidentId: incidents[i].incidentId,
                displayId: incidents[i].displayId,
                newState: incidents[i].newState,
                error: incidents[i].error
            });
        gs.info(TAG + ' ' + label + ' ' + step + ' ' + JSON.stringify({
            ok: outcome.ok,
            status: outcome.status,
            error: outcome.error,
            import_set: outcome.import_set,
            import_set_id: outcome.import_set_id,
            batch_size: outcome.batch_size,
            incidents: summary
        }));
    }

    function buildAlert(suffix) {
        return {
            eventType: 'INCIDENT_CREATED',
            schemaVersion: '1.0',
            alertRuleId: 'zz-deptest-rule',
            itsmType: 'SERVICENOW',
            deviceAlertId: runId + '-device-' + suffix,
            u_id: runId + '-' + suffix,
            u_title: '[TEST deployed ' + suffix + '] Platform-default import check - please ignore',
            u_description: 'Created on 22 Oct 2026 by a temporary test of the deployed AlertIngest, run as incidentConnect. Safe to delete.',
            u_status: '{"name": "NEW", "value": "New"}',
            u_impact: '3',
            u_urgency: '3',
            u_assignmentgroupid: 'Service Desk',
            u_category: 'Software',
            u_subcategory: 'Operating System',
            u_devicedetails: '{"deviceName": "ZZ-TEST-DEVICE"}',
            u_sourcelocation: 'zz-deptest'
        };
    }
})();
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_fix</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 06:12:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>c77797822b44d754eb1cfbfdf291bf81</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ZZ TEST - AM platform-default import che</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_c77797822b44d754eb1cfbfdf291bf81</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 08:44:15</sys_updated_on><unloadable>false</unloadable></sys_script_fix></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_entry"><sys_transform_entry action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><choice_action>ignore</choice_action><coalesce>false</coalesce><coalesce_case_sensitive>false</coalesce_case_sensitive><coalesce_empty_fields>false</coalesce_empty_fields><date_format>yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss</date_format><map display_value="HP WXP Alert to Incident">ccf5939f2b750710eb1cfbfdf291bf79</map><reference_value_field/><source_field>u_impact</source_field><source_script><![CDATA[answer = (function transformEntry(source) {

    var priorityObj = JSON.parse(source.u_priority);

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_fm_wfm');
    gr.addQuery('wrkfrc_exp_key', 'u_priority');
    gr.addQuery('wrkfrc_exp_value', priorityObj.value);
    gr.addQuery('snow_field', 'impact');
    gr.addQuery('active', true);
    gr.query();

    if (gr.next())
        return gr.snow_value;

})(source);]]></source_script><source_table>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_hp_alert_inc_import_set</source_table><sys_class_name>sys_transform_entry</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-06 08:08:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>18466b932b390710eb1cfbfdf291bfbe</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>u_impact</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_entry_18466b932b390710eb1cfbfdf291bfbe</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>jessica.braganza</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-07 10:11:31</sys_updated_on><target_field>impact</target_field><target_table>incident</target_table><use_source_script>false</use_source_script></sys_transform_entry></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json</consumes><consumes_customized>true</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl>0281c6a1eb8f871030f9f95ccad0cd15</enforce_acl><http_method>POST</http_method><name>Post alerts</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(request, response) {

    // Debug log of the call, written only when x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.logging.verbosity is 'debug'.
    // The body can be read only once, so it is taken as text here and parsed below.
    var debug = new AlertApiDebug('POST /alerts');
    var raw = '';
    try {
        raw = request.body.dataString || '';
    } catch (e) {
        raw = '';
    }
    debug.request(request, raw);

    // Authorisation. 'Requires ACL authorization' plus the rest_endpoint ACL is the primary
    // control; this guard is deliberate belt-and-braces, because an ACL can be deactivated
    // on a customer instance and the endpoint would silently reopen. Confirmed 31 Aug 2026
    // that without it a role-less authenticated user could create AND resolve incidents -
    // a re-post coalescing on u_id with status FIXED closes whatever it matches.
    //
    // The response deliberately says nothing about WHICH role is missing - naming it tells a
    // caller exactly what to go after. The detail goes to the system log instead, where
    // support can find it and an outsider cannot.
    if (!gs.hasRole('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.user')) {
        gs.warn('[HP WXP AM] Forbidden POST /alerts - user ' + gs.getUserName() +
                ' does not hold x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.user');
        return fail(403, 'Forbidden.');
    }

    if (!raw)
        return fail(400, 'Send a JSON body containing an "alerts" array.');

    var body;
    try {
        body = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (e) {
        return fail(400, 'Body is not valid JSON.');
    }

    if (!body)
        return fail(400, 'Send a JSON body containing an "alerts" array.');

    // The envelope is { "alerts": [...] }; a bare array is accepted too.
    var alerts = Array.isArray(body) ? body : body.alerts;

    var outcome = new AlertIngest().importBatch(alerts, debug.callId);
    if (!outcome.ok) {
        var errorBody = { error: outcome.error };
        if (outcome.missingFields)
            errorBody.missingFields = outcome.missingFields;
        if (outcome.alertIndex !== undefined && outcome.alertIndex !== null)
            errorBody.alertIndex = outcome.alertIndex;
        response.setStatus(outcome.status);
        debug.response(outcome.status, errorBody);
        return errorBody;
    }

    var result = {
        import_set: outcome.import_set,
        import_set_id: outcome.import_set_id,
        staging_table: outcome.staging_table,
        batch_size: outcome.batch_size,
        incidents: outcome.incidents
    };
    debug.response(200, result);
    return result;

    function fail(status, message) {
        debug.response(status, message);
        var error = new sn_ws_err.ServiceError();
        error.setStatus(status);
        error.setMessage(message);
        return error;
    }

})(request, response);]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam/alerts</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>true</produces_customized><relative_path>/</relative_path><request_example>{
  "alerts": [
    {
      "eventType": "ALERT_CREATED",
      "schemaVersion": "1.0",
      "alertRuleId": "wxp-alert-rule-9876",
      "fleetAlertId": "22527558",
      "deviceAlertId": null,
      "itsmType": "SERVICENOW",
      "u_title": "Unexpected System crash/reboot",
      "u_description": "An unexpected crash or system reboot on device DESKTOP-778U98A. OS: Windows 11.",
      "u_type": "{\"name\":\"OS_HEALTH\",\"value\":\"OS Health\"}",
      "u_subtype": "{\"name\":\"OS_CRASH\",\"value\":\"OS Unexpected Crash/Reboot\"}",
      "u_status": "{\"name\":\"NEW\",\"value\":\"New\"}",
      "u_impact": "2",
      "u_urgency": "2",
      "u_devicedetails": "{\"deviceName\":\"DESKTOP-778U98A\",\"serialNumber\":\"MXL34948XB\"}",
      "u_companydetails": "{\"tenantId\":\"4d196eb0-0e87-49e0-866a-26ffd678ae25\",\"companyName\":\"LDK Demo Prime\"}",
      "u_assignmentgroupid": "<sys_id from /lookups assignmentGroups>",
      "u_category": "hardware",
      "u_subcategory": "cpu"
    }
  ]
}</request_example><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Accepts a batch of up to 100 alerts and returns one incident per alert.</short_description><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-18 15:56:22</sys_created_on><sys_id>cebdee592b760b10eb1cfbfdf291bf0b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>13</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Post alerts</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_cebdee592b760b10eb1cfbfdf291bf0b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 17:44:01</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="HP WXP Alerts">d69d6a592b760b10eb1cfbfdf291bf07</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="DELETE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Utility for Alert Management calibration and setup.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil = Class.create();
WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil.prototype = {

    initialize: function() {},

    runFixScript: function() {

        var LOG = '[Alert Management Calibration] ';
        var errors = [];
        var logs = [];
        var appid = '';

        /* =====================================================
         * Helper functions 
         * ===================================================== */

        // SUCCESS logs. Routine detail goes to gs.debug: written only when
        // x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.logging.verbosity is 'debug'.
        function logInfo(name, value) {
            logs.push({
                name: name,
                status: true,
                message: value || ''
            });
            gs.debug(LOG + name + ' - ' + value);
        }

        // ERROR logs
        function logError(name, value) {
            errors.push(name);
            logs.push({
                name: name,
                status: false,
                message: value || 'Failed'
            });
            gs.error(LOG + name + ' - ' + value);
        }
        // WARN logs (a configuration state, not a failure)
        function logWarn(name, value) {
            errors.push(name);
            logs.push({
                name: name,
                status: false,
                message: value || 'Failed'
            });
            gs.warn(LOG + name + ' - ' + value);
        }

        function getScopeSysID(name) {
            var sysId = gs.getCurrentApplicationId();

            if (sysId) {
                appid = sysId;

                gs.debug(LOG + 'Scope - ' + name);
            } else {
                gs.debug(LOG + 'Scope - Not found: ' + name);
            }
        }

        /* =====================================================
         * API STATUS CHECK
         *
         * Checks that the connection settings are present. The live connection test is off
         * in this version: the only Fastn call available for it (getTenantsChildren) needs a
         * tenant ID, which setup no longer asks for. A tenant-free check returns in v2.
         * ===================================================== */

        function validateAPIConnection() {

            var apiKey = gs.getProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.api.fastn.api.key');
            var baseUrl = gs.getProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn_api_baseurl');
            var spaceId = gs.getProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn.space.id');

            // NOT CONFIGURED
            if (!apiKey) {
                logWarn('API Status', 'Not Configured');
                return;
            }

            // Missing dependencies 
            if (!baseUrl || !spaceId) {
                logWarn('API Status', 'Configured but Missing Required Properties');
                return;
            }

            logInfo('API Status', 'Configured');
        }

        /* =====================================================
         * START
         * ===================================================== */

        gs.debug(LOG + 'Started');

        try {

            /* =====================================================
             * URL Calibration
             * ===================================================== */

            getScopeSysID('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam');

            logInfo('URL Calibration', 'Done');

            /* =====================================================
             * API Status
             * ===================================================== */
            validateAPIConnection();



        } catch (e) {
            logError('Unhandled failure', e.message);
        }

        var finalStatus = errors.length === 0;

        return {
            success: finalStatus,
            message: finalStatus ? 'Setup completed' : 'Setup failed',
            logs: logs
        };
    },

    resetSetup: function() {
        var LOG = '[Alert Management Calibration - RESET] ';


        try {


            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.api.fastn.api.key', '');
            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn_api_baseurl', '');
            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.tenants', '');
            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn.space.id', '');
            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.tenant.type', '');
            gs.setProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.notify_failure_group', '');

            gs.debug(LOG + 'Properties cleared');


            var tenantGr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_tenant_list');
            tenantGr.query();
            tenantGr.deleteMultiple();


            return {
                success: true,
                message: 'Setup reset successful'
            };


        } catch (e) {
            gs.error(LOG + e.message);


            return {
                success: false,
                message: e.message
            };
        }
    },

    type: 'WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-26 08:56:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>b307d2bf2bfecb10eb1cfbfdf291bfe5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>33</sys_mod_count><sys_name>WrkfrcExpAMCalibrationUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_b307d2bf2bfecb10eb1cfbfdf291bfe5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-23 13:34:36</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_transform_entry_4b86ab972b390710eb1cfbfdf291bf95
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_entry"><sys_transform_entry action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><choice_action>ignore</choice_action><coalesce>false</coalesce><coalesce_case_sensitive>false</coalesce_case_sensitive><coalesce_empty_fields>false</coalesce_empty_fields><date_format>yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss</date_format><map display_value="HP WXP Alert to Incident">ccf5939f2b750710eb1cfbfdf291bf79</map><reference_value_field>sys_id</reference_value_field><source_field>[Script]</source_field><source_script><![CDATA[answer = (function transformEntry(source) {

    // Set when the incident is created only. A re-post keeps the CI the incident has: an agent
    // may have corrected it, and with Copy empty fields on, returning nothing here would blank it.
    if (action == 'update')
        return target.getValue('cmdb_ci');

    // The device's CI, matched on serial number. 'Referenced value field name' on this map is
    // sys_id, so the platform takes the returned value as is.
    var device = JSON.parse(source.getValue('u_devicedetails') || '{}');
    if (!device.serialNumber)
        return '';
    var ci = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci');
    ci.addQuery('serial_number', device.serialNumber);
    ci.setLimit(1);
    ci.query();
    return ci.next() ? ci.getUniqueValue() : '';

})(source);
]]></source_script><source_table>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_hp_alert_inc_import_set</source_table><sys_class_name>sys_transform_entry</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-06 08:12:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>4b86ab972b390710eb1cfbfdf291bf95</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>[Script]</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_entry_4b86ab972b390710eb1cfbfdf291bf95</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 18:40:44</sys_updated_on><target_field>cmdb_ci</target_field><target_table>incident</target_table><use_source_script>true</use_source_script></sys_transform_entry></record_update>

// transaction. event.parm1 is the event type; event.parm2 is the attempt number (1 on first send).
// parm1 is a Java string, which JSON.stringify writes as {} - '' + makes it a JavaScript string.
new WrkfrcExpAMAlertUtils().deliverITSMCallback(current, '' + event.parm1, parseInt(event.parm2, 10) || 1);
]]></script><synchronous>false</synchronous><sys_class_name>sysevent_script_action</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 11:57:39</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>0366685aeb08971030f9f95ccad0cd30</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HP WXP AM ITSM Callback</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sysevent_script_action_0366685aeb08971030f9f95ccad0cd30</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 18:56:17</sys_updated_on></sysevent_script_action></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_e79553a92b3acb10eb1cfbfdf291bf0f
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.WrkfrcExpAMAlertUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>Utility for Alert Management</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>WrkfrcExpAMAlertUtils</name><sandbox_callable>true</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var WrkfrcExpAMAlertUtils = Class.create();
WrkfrcExpAMAlertUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    CALLBACK_EVENT: 'x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.itsm.callback',
    CALLBACK_MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3,
    CALLBACK_RETRY_MINUTES: [2, 10],
    HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS: 30000,

    getIdentifier: function() {
        return gs.getProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.identifier');
    },

    isSingleRecord: function() {

        var ga = new GlideAggregate('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_tenant_list');
        ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
        ga.query();

        if (ga.next()) {
            return ga.getAggregate('COUNT') == 1; //returns true  if count is 1 else false
        }

        return false;
    },

    getBaseURL: function() {
        var instance_name = gs.getProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn_api_baseurl');
        return instance_name;
    },

    callAPI: function(restMessageName, params, tenantId) {
        var baseURL = this.getBaseURL();
        if (!baseURL) {
            gs.warn("HP WXP Alert Management: Not configured - the Fastn base URL (x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn_api_baseurl) is empty. Complete the Setup.");
            return this._notSent("Base URL not found.");
        }

        // x-fastn-space-tenantid names the tenant the call is for: the tenant of the alert it acts
        // for (from the Incoming Alert Log), else the connection tenant property. Setup no longer
        // asks for the connection tenant, so only a call with neither is stopped.
        var tenant = ('' + (tenantId || gs.getProperty("x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.tenants", ""))).trim();
        if (!tenant) {
            gs.warn("HP WXP Alert Management: Not sent - no tenant: the alert named none and the connection tenant (x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.tenants) is empty.");
            return this._notSent("No tenant for this call: the alert named none and the connection tenant (x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.tenants) is empty.");
        }

        try {
            var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2('HP WXP Alert Management', restMessageName);
            r.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
            r.setRequestHeader("x-fastn-space-id", gs.getProperty("x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.fastn.space.id"));
            r.setRequestHeader("stage", "LIVE");
            r.setRequestHeader("x-fastn-api-key", gs.getProperty("x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.api.fastn.api.key"));
            r.setRequestHeader("x-fastn-space-tenantid", tenant);
            r.setStringParameterNoEscape('base_url', baseURL);
            for (var param in params) {
                r.setStringParameterNoEscape(param, params[param]);
            }

            // One synchronous call with a timeout. The callback runs it from a Script Action,
            // outside the incident's transaction, so no user or inbound request waits on Fastn.
            r.setHttpTimeout(this.HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS);
            var response = r.execute();
            var httpStatus = parseInt(response.getStatusCode(), 10) || 0;
            return {
                "success": httpStatus > 199 && httpStatus < 300,
                "statusCode": httpStatus,
                "responseBody": response.getBody(),
                "retryable": httpStatus === 0 || httpStatus >= 500
            };
        } catch (e) {
            return {
                "success": false,
                "statusCode": 0,
                "responseBody": '' + e,
                "retryable": true
            };
        }
    },

    _notSent: function(reason) {
        return {
            "success": false,
            "statusCode": 0,
            "responseBody": reason,
            "retryable": false,
            "notSent": true
        };
    },

    _getAlertDetails: function(incidentGR) {

        var result = {
            tenantId: null,
            alertRuleId: null,
            fleetAlertId: null,
            deviceAlertId: null
        };

        // The log row of the alert that created or last updated this incident. tenant_id is the
        // tenant the alert itself named.
        var logGR = new GlideRecordSecure('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_incoming_alert_log');
        logGR.addQuery('incident', incidentGR.getUniqueValue());
        logGR.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        logGR.setLimit(1);
        logGR.query();
        if (logGR.next()) {
            result.tenantId = logGR.getValue('tenant_id') || null;
            result.alertRuleId = logGR.getValue('alert_rule_id') || null;
            result.fleetAlertId = logGR.getValue('fleet_alert_id') || null;
            result.deviceAlertId = logGR.getValue('device_alert_id') || null;
        }
        // A re-post that left the tenant out keeps the tenant an earlier alert for this incident named.
        if (!result.tenantId) {
            var namedGR = new GlideRecordSecure('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_incoming_alert_log');
            namedGR.addQuery('incident', incidentGR.getUniqueValue());
            namedGR.addNotNullQuery('tenant_id');
            namedGR.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
            namedGR.setLimit(1);
            namedGR.query();
            if (namedGR.next())
                result.tenantId = namedGR.getValue('tenant_id');
        }
        // The connection tenant property is only the fallback for an incident no alert named a
        // tenant for. With both empty, callAPI sends nothing.
        result.tenantId = result.tenantId || gs.getProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.tenants') || null;

        return result;
    },

    buildITSMCallbackPayload: function(incidentGR, eventType) {

        var alertDetails = this._getAlertDetails(incidentGR);

        return {
            input: {
                result: {
                    eventType: eventType,
                    schemaVersion: "1.0",
                    tenantId: alertDetails.tenantId,
                    alertRuleId: alertDetails.alertRuleId,
                    fleetAlertId: alertDetails.fleetAlertId,
                    deviceAlertId: alertDetails.deviceAlertId,
                    itsmType: "SERVICENOW",
                    incidentId: incidentGR.getUniqueValue(),
                    displayId: incidentGR.number + '',
                    newState: incidentGR.state.getDisplayValue(),
                    assignedTo: incidentGR.assigned_to.nil() ? null : incidentGR.assigned_to.toString(),
                    resolvedAt: incidentGR.resolved_at.nil() ? null : incidentGR.resolved_at.getDisplayValue(),
                    priority: incidentGR.priority.getDisplayValue(),
                    comments: null,
                    processedAt: new GlideDateTime().getValue().replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z',
                    error: null
                }
            }
        };
    },

    sendITSMCallback: function(incidentGR, eventType) {

        var payload = this.buildITSMCallbackPayload(incidentGR, eventType);

        // The header names the same tenant as the body: the one the incident's alert came from.
        return this.callAPI('ITSM Callback', {
            payload: JSON.stringify(payload)
        }, payload.input.result.tenantId);
    },

    /**
     * Called by the "HP WXP AM ITSM Callback" Script Action, never inside the incident's own save.
     * Retries only when Fastn gave no answer or a 5xx, by scheduling the event again; after the last
     * attempt, or on 401/403, it raises the integration failure event as before.
     */
    deliverITSMCallback: function(incidentGR, eventType, attempt) {
        if (!incidentGR || !incidentGR.isValidRecord())
            return;

        var result = this.sendITSMCallback(incidentGR, eventType);
        if (result.success || result.notSent)
            return;

        if (result.retryable && attempt < this.CALLBACK_MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
            var when = new GlideDateTime();
            when.addSeconds(60 * this.CALLBACK_RETRY_MINUTES[attempt - 1]);
            gs.eventQueueScheduled(this.CALLBACK_EVENT, incidentGR, eventType, '' + (attempt + 1), when);
            return;
        }

        var status = result.statusCode;
        var detail = "restMessage: ITSM Callback, event: " + eventType + ", incident: " + incidentGR.getValue('number') +
            ", attempt: " + attempt + ", httpStatus: " + status + ", responseBody: " + result.responseBody;
        // A 404 or other 4xx means Fastn does not know the alert. That is a data case, not a communication failure.
        if (!status || status === 401 || status === 403 || status >= 500) {
            gs.error("HP WXP Alert Management integration failure - " + detail);
            gs.eventQueue("x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.hp.failure.notify", incidentGR,
                gs.getProperty("x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.notify_failure_group"), result.responseBody + "||" + status);
        } else {
            gs.warn("HP WXP Alert Management request rejected by Fastn - " + detail);
        }
    },

    type: 'WrkfrcExpAMAlertUtils'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-19 13:41:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>e79553a92b3acb10eb1cfbfdf291bf0f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>31</sys_mod_count><sys_name>WrkfrcExpAMAlertUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_e79553a92b3acb10eb1cfbfdf291bf0f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-26 14:35:49</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_entry"><sys_transform_entry action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><choice_action>ignore</choice_action><coalesce>false</coalesce><coalesce_case_sensitive>false</coalesce_case_sensitive><coalesce_empty_fields>false</coalesce_empty_fields><date_format>yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss</date_format><map display_value="HP WXP Alert to Incident">ccf5939f2b750710eb1cfbfdf291bf79</map><reference_value_field/><source_field>u_urgency</source_field><source_script><![CDATA[answer = (function transformEntry(source) {

    var priorityObj = JSON.parse(source.u_priority);

    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_fm_wfm');
    gr.addQuery('wrkfrc_exp_key', 'u_priority');
    gr.addQuery('wrkfrc_exp_value', priorityObj.value);
    gr.addQuery('snow_field', 'urgency');
    gr.addQuery('active', true);
    gr.query();

    if (gr.next())
        return gr.snow_value;

})(source);]]></source_script><source_table>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_hp_alert_inc_import_set</source_table><sys_class_name>sys_transform_entry</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-06 08:04:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>d8b463df2bf50710eb1cfbfdf291bf03</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>u_urgency</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_entry_d8b463df2bf50710eb1cfbfdf291bf03</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>jessica.braganza</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-07 10:10:49</sys_updated_on><target_field>urgency</target_field><target_table>incident</target_table><use_source_script>false</use_source_script></sys_transform_entry></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_d3d37f8bebb2071030f9f95ccad0cd3e
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_tenant_list</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>HP WXP AM: Enforce Single Tenant Active</name><order>1000</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {


    var tenantTable = new GlideRecordSecure(current.getTableName());
    tenantTable.setLimit(2); // no unnecessary querying remaining records
    tenantTable.query();

    var count = 0;

    while (tenantTable.next()) {
        count++;
        if (count > 1) break;
    }

    // include current record if it's insert
    if (current.operation() == 'insert') {
        count++;
    }

    if (count == 1) {
        //Only one record → forcing active = true
        current.active = true;
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-24 07:33:49</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>d3d37f8bebb2071030f9f95ccad0cd3e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HP WXP AM: Enforce Single Tenant Active</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_d3d37f8bebb2071030f9f95ccad0cd3e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>aditi.khanna</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 07:48:14</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=d3d37f8bebb2071030f9f95ccad0cd3e"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_207d62592b760b10eb1cfbfdf291bf8f
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.AlertIngest</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Stages a batch of HP WXP alerts into x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_hp_alert_inc_import_set and runs the 'HP WXP Alert to Incident' transform map synchronously, so the caller gets the incident number back in the same response. Backs the POST /alerts resource of the alert_import Scripted REST API.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AlertIngest</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AlertIngest = Class.create();
AlertIngest.prototype = {
    STAGING_TABLE: 'x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_hp_alert_inc_import_set',
    LOG_TABLE: 'x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_incoming_alert_log',
    INBOUND_FLAG: 'x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.inbound_alert',
    MAX_BATCH: 99,
    REQUIRED_FIELDS: ['eventType', 'schemaVersion', 'alertRuleId', 'itsmType', 'u_title', 'u_impact', 'u_urgency', 'u_assignmentgroupid', 'u_category'],
    MAPPED_FIELDS: ['u_id', 'u_displayid', 'u_title', 'u_description', 'u_status', 'u_impact', 'u_urgency', 'u_assignmentgroupid', 'u_category', 'u_subcategory', 'u_devicedetails', 'u_companydetails', 'u_type', 'u_subtype', 'u_sourcelocation', 'u_alertruleid', 'u_occuredat', 'u_createdat', 'u_updatedat', 'u_tenantid', 'u_userid', 'u_userdetails', 'u_metadata'],
    initialize: function() {},
    // Platform default: the alert rows are inserted straight into the staging table, the way the
    // Import Set API does it. The platform puts each row in the table's Synchronous import set
    // (creating one when none is Loading) and runs the transform map as soon as the row is
    // inserted, so the row comes back with sys_target_sys_id set. No sys_import_set record is
    // created here and GlideImportSetTransformer is not called.
    importBatch: function(alerts, callId) {
        var i;
        if (!alerts || !Array.isArray(alerts))
            return this._reject('Body must contain an "alerts" array.');
        if (alerts.length === 0)
            return this._reject('"alerts" is empty - send at least one alert.');
        if (alerts.length > this.MAX_BATCH)
            return this._reject('Batch of ' + alerts.length + ' alerts exceeds the maximum of ' + this.MAX_BATCH + '.');
        // One ID for every log row of this call; the /alerts debug log uses the same one.
        callId = callId || gs.generateGUID().substring(0, 8);
        var logIds = [];
        for (i = 0; i < alerts.length; i++)
            logIds.push(this._logIncoming(alerts[i], callId));
        var staged = [];
        for (i = 0; i < alerts.length; i++) {
            var mapped = this._toColumns(alerts[i]);
            if (mapped.error) {
                // The whole batch is rejected, so every alert in it is logged as rejected.
                for (var j = 0; j < logIds.length; j++)
                    this._logError(logIds[j], 'alerts[' + i + ']: ' + mapped.error);
                return this._reject('alerts[' + i + ']: ' + mapped.error, mapped.missingFields, i);
            }
            staged.push(mapped.fields);
        }
        // Each insert is transformed before the next one starts, so results come back in order.
        // While the flag is set, the Lifecycle Callback business rule skips the incidents this
        // batch updates, so Fastn is not sent its own change back as a callback.
        var session = gs.getSession();
        var rowIds = [];
        session.putClientData(this.INBOUND_FLAG, 'true');
        try {
            for (i = 0; i < staged.length; i++)
                rowIds.push(this._stageRow(staged[i]));
        } finally {
            session.putClientData(this.INBOUND_FLAG, '');
        }
        var importSet = this._importSetOf(rowIds);
        return {
            ok: true,
            import_set: importSet.number,
            import_set_id: importSet.sysId,
            staging_table: this.STAGING_TABLE,
            batch_size: staged.length,
            incidents: this._results(rowIds, alerts, logIds)
        };
    },
    _stageRow: function(fields) {
        var row = new GlideRecordSecure(this.STAGING_TABLE);
        row.initialize();
        for (var column in fields) {
            if (fields.hasOwnProperty(column))
                row.setValue(column, fields[column]);
        }
        return row.insert();
    },
    /**
     * The import set the platform put the batch in. Rows inserted on one day share one set.
     * GlideRecord, not GlideRecordSecure: the integration user cannot read the row's
     * sys_import_set field, and these are rows this call has just inserted.
     */
    _importSetOf: function(rowIds) {
        for (var i = 0; i < rowIds.length; i++) {
            var row = new GlideRecord(this.STAGING_TABLE);
            if (rowIds[i] && row.get(rowIds[i]) && row.getValue('sys_import_set'))
                return {
                    sysId: row.getValue('sys_import_set'),
                    number: row.getDisplayValue('sys_import_set')
                };
        }
        return {
            sysId: null,
            number: null
        };
    },
    _results: function(rowIds, alerts, logIds) {
        var out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < rowIds.length; i++)
            out.push(this._rowResult(rowIds[i], alerts[i], logIds[i]));
        return out;
    },
    _rowResult: function(rowId, alert, logId) {
        var isFleet = !!alert.fleetAlertId;
        var entry = {
            eventType: alert.eventType,
            schemaVersion: alert.schemaVersion,
            // The alert's own tenant, as its Incoming Alert Log row stores it; the connection
            // tenant only when the alert names none.
            tenantId: this._alertTenant(alert) || this._tenantId(),
            alertRuleId: this._asString(alert.alertRuleId),
            fleetAlertId: isFleet ? this._asString(alert.fleetAlertId) : null,
            deviceAlertId: isFleet ? null : this._asString(alert.deviceAlertId),
            itsmType: alert.itsmType,
            u_id: alert.u_id === undefined ? null : alert.u_id,
            incidentId: null,
            displayId: null,
            newState: null,
            priority: null,
            assignedTo: null,
            resolvedAt: null,
            comments: null,
            processedAt: this._isoNow(),
            error: null
        };
        var row = new GlideRecordSecure(this.STAGING_TABLE);
        if (!rowId || !row.get(rowId)) {
            entry.error = 'The alert could not be staged.';
            this._logResult(logId, entry, 'error');
            return entry;
        }
        var importState = row.getValue('sys_import_state') || 'pending';
        var table = row.getValue('sys_target_table') || '';
        var sysId = row.getValue('sys_target_sys_id') || '';
        if (importState === 'error' || !sysId || !table) {
            entry.error = row.getValue('sys_import_state_comment') || this._importLogError(rowId) ||
                'Transform did not produce an incident.';
            this._logResult(logId, entry, importState === 'ignored' ? 'ignored' : 'error');
            return entry;
        }
        var target = new GlideRecordSecure(table);
        if (target.get(sysId)) {
            entry.incidentId = target.getUniqueValue();
            entry.displayId = target.getValue('number');
            entry.newState = this._stateLabel(target.getValue('state'));
            entry.priority = this._priorityLabel(target.getValue('priority'));
            entry.assignedTo = (target.assigned_to.email + '') || null;
            entry.resolvedAt = target.getValue('resolved_at') || null;
            entry.comments = target.comments.getJournalEntry(1) || null;
        } else {
            entry.error = 'Target record ' + sysId + ' not found on ' + table + '.';
        }
        this._logResult(logId, entry, entry.error ? 'error' : importState, entry.incidentId);
        return entry;
    },
    /**
     * The platform's own reason for a row it rejected, such as a data policy exception. The
     * transformer writes it to import_log against the row, not to the row's comment.
     * GlideRecord, not GlideRecordSecure: import_log is readable only by import_admin, and this
     * is the log of a row this call has just inserted.
     */
    _importLogError: function(rowId) {
        var log = new GlideRecord('import_log');
        log.addQuery('import_set_row', rowId);
        log.addQuery('level', 2);
        log.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        log.setLimit(1);
        log.query();
        return log.next() ? ('' + log.getValue('message')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : '';
    },
    /**
     * The alert details written to the incident: as the work note on every post, and under the
     * description when the incident is created. source is the staging row. Only the lines that
     * carry a value are written, so a sparse alert does not produce a list of empty labels.
     */
    alertDetails: function(source) {
        var company = JSON.parse(source.getValue('u_companydetails') || '{}');
        var device = JSON.parse(source.getValue('u_devicedetails') || '{}');
        var lines = [
            ['Company Name', company.companyName],
            ['Device Name', device.deviceName],
            ['Serial Number', device.serialNumber],
            ['Device Model', device.deviceModel],
            ['Alert Type', this._alertLabel(source.getValue('u_type'))],
            ['Alert Subtype', this._alertLabel(source.getValue('u_subtype'))],
            ['Alert Status', this._alertLabel(source.getValue('u_status'))],
            ['Source Location', source.getValue('u_sourcelocation') || ''],
            ['Alert Rule', source.getValue('u_alertruleid') || ''],
            ['Occurred At', this._alertStamp(source.getValue('u_occuredat'))]
        ];
        var out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            if (lines[i][1])
                out.push(lines[i][0] + ': ' + lines[i][1]);
        }
        return out.join('\n');
    },
    /** type/subtype/status arrive as stringified {"name":...,"value":...} - show the label. */
    _alertLabel: function(field) {
        var raw = ('' + (field || '')).trim();
        if (!raw)
            return '';
        try {
            var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
            return parsed.value || parsed.name || raw;
        } catch (e) {
            return raw;
        }
    },
    /**
     * WXP sends epoch milliseconds as a string. getValue(), not getDisplayValue(): GlideDateTime
     * holds UTC, and getDisplayValue() would render it in whichever user's timezone ran the
     * import, frozen into the text. The zone is labelled so a reader knows what it is.
     */
    _alertStamp: function(millis) {
        var value = Number('' + (millis || ''));
        if (!value)
            return '';
        var when = new GlideDateTime();
        when.setNumericValue(value);
        return when.getValue() + ' UTC';
    },
    _toColumns: function(alert) {
        if (!alert || typeof alert !== 'object' || Array.isArray(alert))
            return {
                error: 'Expected an object.'
            };
        var i;
        var missing = [];
        for (i = 0; i < this.REQUIRED_FIELDS.length; i++) {
            if (!alert[this.REQUIRED_FIELDS[i]])
                missing.push(this.REQUIRED_FIELDS[i]);
        }
        var hasFleet = !!alert.fleetAlertId;
        var hasDevice = !!alert.deviceAlertId;
        if (!hasFleet && !hasDevice)
            missing.push('fleetAlertId or deviceAlertId');
        if (missing.length)
            return {
                error: 'Missing required field(s): ' + missing.join(', ') + '.',
                missingFields: missing
            };
        if (hasFleet && hasDevice)
            return {
                error: 'Exactly one of "fleetAlertId" or "deviceAlertId" is required, not both.'
            };
        var identifier = hasFleet ? alert.fleetAlertId : alert.deviceAlertId;
        var fields = {
            u_alert_rule_id: this._asString(alert.alertRuleId),
            u_alert_id: this._asString(identifier)
        };
        for (i = 0; i < this.MAPPED_FIELDS.length; i++) {
            var key = this.MAPPED_FIELDS[i];
            if (alert.hasOwnProperty(key))
                fields[key] = this._asString(alert[key]);
        }
        return {
            fields: fields
        };
    },
    _logIncoming: function(alert, callId) {
        try {
            var isFleet = !!(alert && alert.fleetAlertId);
            var entry = {
                eventType: alert && alert.eventType,
                schemaVersion: alert && alert.schemaVersion,
                tenantId: ((alert && typeof alert === 'object') ? this._alertTenant(alert) : '') || this._tenantId(),
                alertRuleId: alert && alert.alertRuleId,
                fleetAlertId: isFleet ? alert.fleetAlertId : null,
                deviceAlertId: isFleet ? null : (alert && alert.deviceAlertId),
                itsmType: alert && alert.itsmType,
                u_id: (alert && alert.u_id !== undefined) ? alert.u_id : null,
                incidentId: null,
                displayId: null,
                newState: null,
                priority: null,
                assignedTo: null,
                resolvedAt: null,
                comments: null,
                processedAt: this._isoNow(),
                error: null
            };
            var log = new GlideRecordSecure(this.LOG_TABLE);
            log.initialize();
            log.setValue('alert_data', JSON.stringify(entry));
            log.setValue('call_id', callId || '');
            // The alert exactly as Fastn sent it, and its identifiers as columns for searching.
            log.setValue('request_payload', JSON.stringify(alert));
            if (alert && typeof alert === 'object') {
                log.setValue('alert_uid', this._asString(alert.u_id));
                log.setValue('alert_rule_id', this._asString(alert.alertRuleId));
                log.setValue('device_alert_id', this._asString(alert.deviceAlertId));
                log.setValue('fleet_alert_id', this._asString(alert.fleetAlertId));
                log.setValue('event_type', this._asString(alert.eventType));
                log.setValue('schema_version', this._asString(alert.schemaVersion));
                log.setValue('alert_status', this._statusName(alert.u_status));
                log.setValue('tenant_id', this._alertTenant(alert));
            }
            return log.insert();
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('AlertIngest._logIncoming failed: ' + e);
            return null;
        }
    },
    _logResult: function(logId, entry, result, incidentId) {
        if (!logId)
            return;
        try {
            var log = new GlideRecordSecure(this.LOG_TABLE);
            if (!log.get(logId))
                return;
            log.setValue('alert_data', JSON.stringify(entry));
            log.setValue('result', result || '');
            log.setValue('error', entry.error || '');
            if (incidentId)
                log.setValue('incident', incidentId);
            log.update();
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('AlertIngest._logResult failed: ' + e);
        }
    },
    _logError: function(logId, message) {
        if (!logId)
            return;
        try {
            var log = new GlideRecordSecure(this.LOG_TABLE);
            if (!log.get(logId))
                return;
            var entry = {};
            try {
                entry = JSON.parse(log.getValue('alert_data') || '{}');
            } catch (e2) {
                entry = {};
            }
            entry.error = message;
            log.setValue('alert_data', JSON.stringify(entry));
            log.setValue('result', 'rejected');
            log.setValue('error', message);
            log.update();
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('AlertIngest._logError failed: ' + e);
        }
    },
    _tenantId: function() {
        return gs.getProperty('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.tenants', '');
    },
    /** The tenant the alert itself names: u_tenantid, else the tenantId inside u_companydetails. */
    _alertTenant: function(alert) {
        if (alert.u_tenantid)
            return this._asString(alert.u_tenantid);
        try {
            var company = alert.u_companydetails;
            if (typeof company === 'string')
                company = JSON.parse(company || '{}');
            return (company && company.tenantId) ? '' + company.tenantId : '';
        } catch (e) {
            return '';
        }
    },
    /** u_status arrives as a stringified {"name":"NEW","value":"New"}; a bare "NEW" also works. */
    _statusName: function(field) {
        var raw = (field && typeof field === 'object') ? JSON.stringify(field) : ('' + (field || '')).trim();
        if (!raw)
            return '';
        try {
            var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object')
                return ('' + parsed).toUpperCase();
            return ('' + (parsed.name || parsed.value || '')).toUpperCase();
        } catch (e) {
            return raw.toUpperCase();
        }
    },
    _isoNow: function() {
        var v = new GlideDateTime().getValue();
        return v.substring(0, 10) + 'T' + v.substring(11) + 'Z';
    },
    _stateLabel: function(rawState) {
        var labels = {
            '1': 'New',
            '2': 'In Progress',
            '3': 'On Hold',
            '6': 'Resolved',
            '7': 'Closed',
            '8': 'Canceled'
        };
        return labels[rawState] || '';
    },
    _priorityLabel: function(rawPriority) {
        var labels = {
            '1': 'Critical',
            '2': 'High',
            '3': 'Moderate',
            '4': 'Low',
            '5': 'Planning'
        };
        return labels[rawPriority] || '';
    },
    _asString: function(value) {
        if (value === null || value === undefined)
            return '';
        if (typeof value === 'object')
            return JSON.stringify(value);
        return '' + value;
    },
    _reject: function(message, missingFields, alertIndex) {
        var result = {
            ok: false,
            status: 400,
            error: message
        };
        if (missingFields)
            result.missingFields = missingFields;
        if (alertIndex !== undefined && alertIndex !== null)
            result.alertIndex = alertIndex;
        return result;
    },
    type: 'AlertIngest'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-18 15:55:10</sys_created_on><sys_id>207d62592b760b10eb1cfbfdf291bf8f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>27</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AlertIngest</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_207d62592b760b10eb1cfbfdf291bf8f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-26 14:23:05</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_entry"><sys_transform_entry action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><choice_action>ignore</choice_action><coalesce>false</coalesce><coalesce_case_sensitive>false</coalesce_case_sensitive><coalesce_empty_fields>false</coalesce_empty_fields><date_format>yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss</date_format><map display_value="HP WXP Alert to Incident">ccf5939f2b750710eb1cfbfdf291bf79</map><reference_value_field/><source_field>[Script]</source_field><source_script><![CDATA[answer = (function transformEntry(source) {

    // The alert lifecycle drives the incident lifecycle. A re-post coalesces onto the same incident,
    // so a later FIXED or DISMISSED closes the incident the first NEW opened instead of leaving it
    // hanging.
    var status = alertStatus(source.u_status);
    if (status === 'FIXED')
        return 6; // Resolved
    if (status === 'DISMISSED')
        return 8; // Canceled
    if (action == 'insert')
        return 1; // New
    // A re-posted NEW must not drag an incident someone is already working back to New, and with
    // Copy empty fields on, returning nothing would blank the state - so keep what it has.
    return target.getValue('state');

    /** u_status arrives as a stringified {"name":"NEW","value":"New"}; a bare "NEW" also works. */
    function alertStatus(field) {
        var raw = ('' + (field || '')).trim();
        if (!raw)
            return '';
        try {
            var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
            return ('' + (parsed.name || parsed.value || '')).toUpperCase();
        } catch (e) {
            return raw.toUpperCase();
        }
    }

})(source);]]></source_script><source_table>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_hp_alert_inc_import_set</source_table><sys_class_name>sys_transform_entry</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 12:25:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>21ccec162b041b54eb1cfbfdf291bfd9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>[Script]</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_entry_21ccec162b041b54eb1cfbfdf291bfd9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 12:25:24</sys_updated_on><target_field>state</target_field><target_table>incident</target_table><use_source_script>true</use_source_script></sys_transform_entry></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl>c9314a61eb8f871030f9f95ccad0cd31</enforce_acl><http_method>GET</http_method><name>Get lookups</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(request, response) {

    // Debug log of the call, written only when x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.logging.verbosity is 'debug'.
    var debug = new AlertApiDebug('GET /lookups');
    debug.request(request);

    // Authorisation. 'Requires ACL authorization' plus the rest_endpoint ACL is the primary
    // control; this guard is deliberate belt-and-braces, because an ACL can be deactivated
    // on a customer instance and the endpoint would silently reopen. Confirmed 31 Aug 2026
    // that without it any authenticated user could read every group and category.
    //
    // The response deliberately says nothing about WHICH role is missing - naming it tells a
    // caller exactly what to go after. The detail goes to the system log instead, where
    // support can find it and an outsider cannot.
    if (!gs.hasRole('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.user')) {
        gs.warn('[HP WXP AM] Forbidden GET /lookups - user ' + gs.getUserName() +
                ' does not hold x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.user');
        var denied = new sn_ws_err.ServiceError();
        denied.setStatus(403);
        denied.setMessage('Forbidden.');
        debug.response(403, 'Forbidden.');
        return denied;
    }

    var lookups = new AlertConfigLookups();
    var etag = lookups.getETag();

    response.setHeader('ETag', etag);
    response.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'private, max-age=300');
    response.setHeader('Vary', 'Accept-Encoding');

    // The caller always sends If-None-Match, so one request covers both bootstrap and
    // steady state: unchanged data costs a 304 with no body. An empty or absent header
    // cannot match, so a first call falls through to 200 without the caller needing a
    // special case. RFC 7232 permits a comma-separated list of validators and some
    // clients and proxies strip the weak prefix, so compare tolerantly rather than by
    // exact string equality - otherwise caching silently never engages.
    if (matchesEtag(request.getHeader('If-None-Match'), etag)) {
        response.setStatus(304);
        debug.response(304, { etag: etag });
        return;
    }

    var result = lookups.getLookups();
    debug.response(200, {
        etag: etag,
        assignmentGroups: result.assignmentGroups.length,
        categories: result.categories.length
    });
    return result;

    function matchesEtag(header, current) {
        if (!header)
            return false;
        var wanted = normalise(current);
        var candidates = ('' + header).split(',');
        for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
            if (normalise(candidates[i]) === wanted)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** Trim, drop a leading W/, drop surrounding quotes. '*' is deliberately not honoured. */
    function normalise(value) {
        return ('' + value).trim().replace(/^W\//i, '').replace(/^"/, '').replace(/"$/, '');
    }

})(request, response);]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam/lookups</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>true</produces_customized><relative_path>/</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>false</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Assignment groups, categories and subcategories for the alert-configuration page</short_description><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-18 15:56:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>f6bdee592b760b10eb1cfbfdf291bf96</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get lookups</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_f6bdee592b760b10eb1cfbfdf291bf96</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 17:27:53</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="HP WXP Alert Lookups">439daa592b760b10eb1cfbfdf291bf81</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_27f1b9d62b005b54eb1cfbfdf291bf2b
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.AlertApiDebug</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Debug log of calls to the /alerts and /lookups APIs, controlled by x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.logging.verbosity.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AlertApiDebug</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AlertApiDebug = Class.create();
AlertApiDebug.prototype = {
    // Debug log of calls to the /alerts and /lookups APIs, written to Application Logs with
    // gs.debug(). It writes only when x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.logging.verbosity - the platform's
    // log-level property for this scope - is 'debug'; at any other level nothing is built.
    VERBOSITY_PROPERTY: 'x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.logging.verbosity',
    // Authorization and cookie headers are never logged.
    HEADERS: ['content-type', 'content-length', 'accept', 'if-none-match', 'user-agent', 'x-forwarded-for'],
    // syslog.message holds 4000 characters; longer text is written in numbered parts.
    CHUNK: 3800,

    initialize: function(endpoint) {
        this.endpoint = endpoint;
        this.enabled = gs.getProperty(this.VERBOSITY_PROPERTY, 'info') == 'debug';
        this.started = new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue();
        // Always set: AlertIngest stamps it on every Incoming Alert Log row of the call.
        this.callId = gs.generateGUID().substring(0, 8);
    },

    /** The call as received; rawBody is the request body exactly as sent, when there is one. */
    request: function(request, rawBody) {
        if (!this.enabled)
            return;
        var headers = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < this.HEADERS.length; i++) {
            var value = request.getHeader(this.HEADERS[i]);
            if (value)
                headers[this.HEADERS[i]] = '' + value;
        }
        this._write('request', JSON.stringify({
            user: gs.getUserName(),
            url: '' + request.url,
            headers: headers
        }));
        if (rawBody !== undefined)
            this._write('body', rawBody || '(empty)');
    },

    /** What the call returned, and how long it took. */
    response: function(status, body) {
        if (!this.enabled)
            return;
        var elapsed = new GlideDateTime().getNumericValue() - this.started;
        this._write('response', 'HTTP ' + status + ' in ' + elapsed + ' ms' +
            (body === undefined ? '' : ' ' + (typeof body === 'string' ? body : JSON.stringify(body))));
    },

    _write: function(kind, text) {
        var prefix = '[HP WXP AM API] ' + this.endpoint + ' ' + this.callId + ' ' + kind;
        var parts = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(text.length / this.CHUNK));
        for (var p = 0; p < parts; p++) {
            // The text goes in as a parameter so braces in JSON are never read as placeholders.
            gs.debug(prefix + (parts > 1 ? ' (' + (p + 1) + '/' + parts + ')' : '') + ': {0}',
                text.substr(p * this.CHUNK, this.CHUNK));
        }
    },

    type: 'AlertApiDebug'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 17:27:49</sys_created_on><sys_id>27f1b9d62b005b54eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AlertApiDebug</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_27f1b9d62b005b54eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 17:44:04</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_transform_entry_6c1c28d6eb48971030f9f95ccad0cd46
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_entry"><sys_transform_entry action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><choice_action>ignore</choice_action><coalesce>false</coalesce><coalesce_case_sensitive>false</coalesce_case_sensitive><coalesce_empty_fields>false</coalesce_empty_fields><date_format>yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss</date_format><map display_value="HP WXP Alert to Incident">ccf5939f2b750710eb1cfbfdf291bf79</map><reference_value_field>sys_id</reference_value_field><source_field>[Script]</source_field><source_script><![CDATA[answer = (function transformEntry(source) {

    // A re-post must not touch the caller: an agent may have corrected it, and with Copy empty
    // fields on, returning nothing here would blank it.
    if (action == 'update')
        return target.getValue('caller_id');

    // The alert's user when they exist in ServiceNow, otherwise the integration user creating the
    // incident - this transform runs inside the /alerts request, in that user's session.
    // 'Referenced value field name' on this map is sys_id, so the platform takes the value as is.
    var user = JSON.parse(source.u_userdetails || '{}');
    return findCaller(user) || gs.getUserID();

    /** Match the alert's user to a ServiceNow user by email, then by user name. */
    function findCaller(details) {
        var attempts = [
            { field: 'email', value: details.emailId },
            { field: 'user_name', value: details.userName },
            { field: 'name', value: details.userName }
        ];
        for (var i = 0; i < attempts.length; i++) {
            if (!attempts[i].value)
                continue;
            var candidate = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
            candidate.addQuery(attempts[i].field, attempts[i].value);
            candidate.addQuery('active', true);
            candidate.setLimit(1);
            candidate.query();
            if (candidate.next())
                return candidate.getUniqueValue();
        }
        return '';
    }

})(source);]]></source_script><source_table>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_hp_alert_inc_import_set</source_table><sys_class_name>sys_transform_entry</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-22 12:22:19</sys_created_on><sys_id>6c1c28d6eb48971030f9f95ccad0cd46</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>[Script]</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_entry_6c1c28d6eb48971030f9f95ccad0cd46</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 12:22:19</sys_updated_on><target_field>caller_id</target_field><target_table>incident</target_table><use_source_script>true</use_source_script></sys_transform_entry></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>incident</collection><condition>gs.getSession().getClientData('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.inbound_alert') != 'true'</condition><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="incident">correlation_display=HP WXP Alert Management^EQ<item endquery="false" field="correlation_display" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value="HP WXP Alert Management"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>HP WXP AM Lifecycle Callback</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    // Work out what changed here, while previous is still available, and leave the Fastn call to
    // the "HP WXP AM ITSM Callback" Script Action, so this save never waits on Fastn.
    var eventType = 'INCIDENT_UPDATED';
    if (current.state == 6 || current.state == 7) // Resolved, Closed
        eventType = 'INCIDENT_RESOLVED';
    else if (current.assigned_to.changes())
        eventType = 'INCIDENT_ASSIGNED';

    gs.eventQueue('x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam.itsm.callback', current, eventType, '1');
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-24 11:51:25</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>188710952babc310eb1cfbfdf291bfc3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>17</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HP WXP AM Lifecycle Callback</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_188710952babc310eb1cfbfdf291bfc3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-22 11:57:39</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=188710952babc310eb1cfbfdf291bfc3"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_entry"><sys_transform_entry action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><choice_action>create</choice_action><coalesce>false</coalesce><coalesce_case_sensitive>false</coalesce_case_sensitive><coalesce_empty_fields>false</coalesce_empty_fields><date_format>yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss</date_format><map display_value="HP WXP Alert to Incident">ccf5939f2b750710eb1cfbfdf291bf79</map><reference_value_field/><source_field>[Script]</source_field><source_script><![CDATA[answer = (function transformEntry(source) {

    // Names this app specifically, not the WXP platform in general. The HP WXP Event
    // Management app (x_hpws_wrkfrc_exp) writes "HP Workforce Experience Platform" into
    // this same field from its own em_alert pipeline. On an instance running both, a
    // shared value makes an incident's provenance ambiguous and gives the two integrations
    // no way to tell their own records apart.
    return 'HP WXP Alert Management';

})(source);]]></source_script><source_table>x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam_hp_alert_inc_import_set</source_table><sys_class_name>sys_transform_entry</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jessica.braganza</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-06 08:18:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>d948e39b2b390710eb1cfbfdf291bfc5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>[Script]</sys_name><sys_package display_value="HP WXP Alert Management" source="x_hpws_wrkfrcexpam">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="HP WXP Alert Management">fb68f3922bf94750eb1cfbfdf291bf2b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_entry_d948e39b2b390710eb1cfbfdf291bfc5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>saurav.sarkar</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-18 19:17:19</sys_updated_on><target_field>correlation_display</target_field><target_table>incident</target_table><use_source_script>true</use_source_script></sys_transform_entry></record_update>
